analysis.label: 28-day all-cause mortality: systemic corticosteroids versus usual care or placebo, fixed-effect meta-analysis
analysis.quote: Five trials reported mortality at 28 days, 1 trial at 21 days, and 1 trial at 30 days. There were 222 deaths among the 678 patients randomized to corticosteroids and 425 deaths among the 1025 patients randomized to usual care or placebo (summary OR, 0.66 [95% CI, 0.53-0.82]; P < .001 based on a fixed-effect meta-analysis).

analysis.label: Composite cardiovascular death and hospitalization or urgent visits for heart failure (CVD/HHF) in HFmrEF/HFpEF (Fig. 1A)
analysis.quote: Primary outcome of cardiovascular death (CVD) and hospitalization or urgent visits for heart failure (HHF) were reported by all 5 studies. Pooled analysis showed that compared to placebo, SGLT2i use was significantly associated with reduced risk of CVD/HHF outcomes in HFmrEF/HFpEF (pooled HR 0.80, 95% CI: 0.74, 0.86, p < 0.001, I 2 = 0%) ( Fig. 1 A).
